content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan often face significant barriers when trying to sell their products online. Lemon Squeezy, another popular choice, follows suit with its own restrictions. This creates a critical infrastructure problem: how can creators in these restricted countries sell digital products effectively and securely? The answer lies in exploring alternatives that prioritize sovereignty and accessibility.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy positions itself as a user-friendly platform for [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-18|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/selling-plugins-without-payment-processor-what-actually-how-6|Selling Plugins]] digital products, but it operates under strict country restrictions, limiting access for many creators. Stripe, while popular, is available in only 46 of the 195 countries, leaving a significant portion of the global market untouched. PayPal offers some flexibility but can suspend accounts without appeal, locking funds for up to 180 days, a precarious situation for creators relying on cash flow. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack offers complete autonomy, deploying a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, free from the limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms often lack a clear strategy for creators in restricted countries. They may provide services in a limited number of regions, but when it comes to countries like Nigeria or Ghana, creators are left out. Stripe's geographical limitations compound the issue as many creators cannot access its services. PayPal provides some international services, but its account suspension policies create an inherent risk for users in these regions. In contrast, COREMERCH's approach is designed specifically for those locked out of traditional systems, facilitating access to a global marketplace without the usual restrictions, allowing creators to sell freely and securely.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed is crucial for digital creators. Platforms like PayPal may offer instant transactions, but the threat of account suspensions can lead to significant downtime. Stripe provides fast processing but charges additional fees for transactions, particularly when dealing with cross-border payments. Lemon Squeezy has its own fee structure that can be restrictive. Conversely, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack utilizes NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with only a 0.5% transaction fee and low-cost networks like BSC and Solana, ensuring creators receive their funds quickly and affordably.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with true ownership.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital assets is paramount for creators, yet traditional platforms often retain control over funds and customer data. Lemon Squeezy and Stripe have policies that may restrict a creator's access or rights to their own products. PayPal’s suspension policies can exacerbate this issue. In stark contrast, COREMERCH provides a sovereign solution where creators retain full ownership post-deployment, ensuring their data and assets are secure. Automated delivery and payment processing mean creators can focus on their craft while maintaining control over their business.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When evaluating options, it's crucial to consider the specific needs of your business. If you're in a restricted country and require immediate access to payment processing without the risk of account suspension, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is the optimal choice. It offers a seamless deployment process, with features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and a robust backend built on Cloudflare Pages and Workers. Those stuck with Lemon Squeezy or Stripe may find themselves facing unforeseen obstacles. Choosing a sovereign solution ensures that you build your infrastructure on your terms, free from external limitations.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Say goodbye to account suspensions and payment delays.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
